mostWorthwhile.text: Concentrating icy pebbles with gas drag was most worthwhile: the explanation introduced collective feedback and streaming instability, contrasting it with the rocky pressure trap.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making icy pebbles with gentle collisions felt least distinctive because it repeated the rocky starting pattern, though it was useful progress.

surprise.text: I expected gas drag to make icy pebbles drift, but it directly produced a concentrated swarm through collective feedback.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each had a clear role in growing or concentrating solids.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how these small bodies build worlds and deliver water, because the distinct growth mechanisms made the natural processes engaging.
